region: Semarang and surrounding regencies, Central Java, Indonesia
referenceSpatialScope: northern and eastern Semarang and Demak regional hotspot; NOT an exact Tanjung Emas harbour asset measurement
method: InSAR C-band Sentinel-1 time-series with new SBAS technique

publication.title: Present-day land subsidence over Semarang revealed by time series InSAR new small baseline subset technique
publication.journal: International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation

historicalFrameReference.purpose: A separate published Semarang study used this LiCSAR frame; not proof of a velocity product ingested into BARUNA.

limitations: This is the published maximum for a wider region and past period, NOT a measurement at the BIG Tanjung Emas point.
Do not plot these regional findings as a velocity heatmap or as asset-level predictions.
The historical LiCSAR frame referenced by another study does not establish that a ready-to-use velocity raster has been retrieved here.
Regional SBAS velocity and 2005 cumulative levelling settlement must not be compared directly or divided by a duration to invent a current rate.
